title: HDLC: Add correct address parsing per Green Book specification
description:
The previous version did not check the size of hdlc addresses. Now support for address parsing has been added in accordance with the DLMS/COSEM standard.

This is a generated dissector, you need to fix this in the template or .cfg file in epan/dissectors/asn1/cosem, then regenerate

Presumably you mean "DLMS/COSEM", not "HDLC" - Wireshark doesn't have a dissector for HDLC ([ISO/IEC 13239:2002](https://www.iso.org/standard/37010.html)) *per se*, although it does have a dissector for the protocol on which HDLC was based, [SDLC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_Data_Link_Control), dissectors form HDLC-derived protocols (LAPB, LAPD, 802.2 LLC, etc.), and some common code for use all those dissectors (epan/dissectors/packet-xdlc.c).
